response.justification: Candidate is a highly skilled software engineer with strong systems-level thinking and performance optimization experience, but the Principal Performance Architect role fundamentally requires deep expertise in SoC/IP modeling, GPU architecture, and AI accelerator hardware design—areas where the candidate has no demonstrated experience. This represents a significant domain mismatch unsuitable for a principal-level hardware optimization position.
strengths: Strong systems-level performance optimization experience from building low-latency micro-services handling millions of requests per second at scale
14+ years of professional engineering experience exceeding the bachelor's degree qualification requirement
Demonstrated expertise in infrastructure, AI-agent systems, and working with complex distributed systems
concerns: Zero demonstrated experience in SoC/IP modeling or hardware design tools—a core required technical skill for the role
No background in GPU architecture, AI accelerators, or hardware-software co-design at the chip level
Career entirely focused on software engineering and web services with no foundation in hardware architecture or performance analysis at the hardware level

key_factors.factor: Missing SoC/IP Modeling and Hardware Design Expertise
Absence of GPU/AI Accelerator Architecture Background
Strong Systems-Level Thinking and Performance Optimization Skills
